nodes.name: Bulgogi Ground Turkey
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In sauté pan or rondeau over medium-high heat, cook ground turkey until browned. Drain. 2. Add BBQ sauce and gochujang. Mix well. Bring to a simmer, then remove from heat. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

nodes.name: Sesame Spinach
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In mixing bowl, combine soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, sugar and sesame seeds. Using whisk, mix well so that sugar dissolves. 2. Add marinade to well-drained spinach. Mix well to distribute marinade and sesame seeds. 3. Cover. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in a recipe.
nodes.special_instructions: 1-oz spoodle = 1 oz 2-oz spoodle = 2 oz 3-oz spoodle = 3 oz 4-oz spoodle = 4 oz 6-oz spoodle = 6 oz 8-oz spoodle = 8 oz

nodes.name: Gochujang Beef Bowl
nodes.assembly_instructions: FOR 1 SERVING: 1. In center of specified serving container, place 1 each #8 scoops Rice. 2. Place the following over Rice: 2-oz spoodle Beef 3. Arrange the following around Rice: 1-oz spoodle Daikon 1-oz spoodle Pickled Cucumber 1-oz spoodle Kimchi 4. Layer the following on top of Beef: 1 Fried Egg 1 tbl Gochujang sauce 1 tbl scallion 5. Serve immediately.

nodes.name: Gochujang Bulgogi Beef
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. On griddle or in saute pan over medium-high heat, heat oil. 3. Add beef. Cook 1 minute. Using 2 metal spatulas, turn beef and begin pulling beef apart. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until beef is browned and internal temperature reaches 160 F, 3-4 minutes. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

nodes.name: Pickled Carrot & Daikon
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Combine vinegar and sugar. Whisk until well blended. Add daikon and carrot. Toss to coat. Let stand 2 hours or overnight. Drain. 2. Cover. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in recipe.

nodes.name: Korean BBQ Tofu
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In saute pan or wok over high heat, heat oil. Add tofu. Stir-fry until browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from pan. 2. To same pan, add broccoli, onion, cabbage, carrot and celery. Stir-fry until tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. 3. Add cooked tofu and sauce. Stir-fry until coated and heated through. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service. EXHIBITION SERVICE FOR EACH 6 (1/2 cup) SERVINGS: 1. In saucepan or wok over high heat, heat 1 1/2 tsp oil. 2. Add the following: 2 each 6-oz spoodles tofu Stir-fry until browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from pan. 3. To same pan, add: 8-oz spoodle broccoli 6-oz spoodle onion 6-oz spoodle cabbage 3-oz spoodle carrot 3-oz spoodle celery Stir-fry until vegetables are tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. 4. Add: Cooked tofu 6-oz ladle sauce Stir-fry until coated and heated through, 2 to 3 minutes. TO PLATE 1 SERVING: 1. On serving plate, place the following: 4-oz spoodle stir-fry mixture 2. Serve immediately.

nodes.name: TURKEY GD ROTINI 10/3
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, bring water, base, gingerroot, soy sauce, salt, Thai seasoning and sugar to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 5 minutes. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. In serving bowl, place the following: 3-oz spoodle Noodles 1-oz spoodle carrot 1-oz spoodle bean sprouts 2-oz spoodle tofu 1 tbl scallion 3 slices jalapeno 1 tsp cilantro 8-oz ladle broth 1 leaf basil 2. Serve immediately with 1 wedge lime.

nodes.name: Korean BBQ Chicken
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Combine chicken and marinade. Toss to coat. 2. Place chicken with marinade in covered non-reactive shallow pan(s) or sealable plastic bag(s). Refrigerate 1 hour. 3. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 4. Drain chicken. Discard marinade. 5. Cook chicken strips 2 minutes. Turn strips over. Brush with BBQ sauce. Cook until caramelized, 2 to 3 minutes. 6. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.
nodes.special_instructions: 2-oz spoodle = 2 oz 3-oz spoodle = 3 oz 4-oz spoodle = 4 oz 6-oz spoodle = 6 oz 8-oz spoodle = 8 oz

nodes.name: Kimchi
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat steamer. 2. In 2" perforated steam table pan(s), steam cabbage 2 minutes. Drain. 3. Immediately rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process. Drain. 4. Cover. 5. Combine vinegar, fish sauce, Gochujang paste, garlic and gingerroot. Whisk until well blended. 2. Combine all ingredients. Toss to mix. 3. Cover. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in recipe.

nodes.name: Gochujang Sauce
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 300 F. 2. On sheet pan(s), spread sesame seed in thin layer. 3. Bake, stirring once, until lightly toasted and aromatic, 4 to 6 minutes. Cool. 4. Combine all ingredients. Whisk until well blended. 5. Cover. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in recipe.

nodes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In saute pan over medium-high heat, heat oil. 2. Add gingerroot and garlic. Saute until aromatic, 30 seconds. 3. Add Kimchi and scallion. Saute until tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. 4. Add Rice. Saute until heated through. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service.

nodes.name: Korean Noodle Bowl
nodes.assembly_instructions: FOR 1 SERVING: 1. In center of specified serving plate, place 4-oz spoodle noodles. 2. Arrange the following around noodles: 2-oz spoodle tofu 2-oz spoodle mushrooms 6-oz ladle broth 1-oz spoodle kimchi 1-oz spoodle carrot daikon 3. Top with 1 tbsp scallion 4. Serve immediately.

nodes.name: Spicy Asian Burrito
nodes.assembly_instructions: FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following across center of 1 tortilla: #12 scoop Basmati Rice #8 scoop Asian Coleslaw 1-oz spoodle Sriracha Edamame 2-oz spoodle snow peas Fold lower third of tortilla up over filling. Fold in right and left edges of tortilla about 1" on each side. Roll burrito closed. Place seam side down. 2. Cut diagonally in half. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service.

nodes.name: Crispy Sesame Tofu
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 2. Combine tofu and soy sauce. Toss gently to coat. 3. In mixing bowl, combine cornstarch, salt and sesame seeds. Toss to mix. 4. Combine tofu mixture and cornstarch mixture. Toss to coat. 5. Fry tofu until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain. Cool. 6. Cover. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in recipe.
nodes.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full. 1-oz spoodle = 1/2 ozw 2-oz spoodle = 1 ozw 3-oz spoodle = 1 1/2 ozw 4-oz spoodle = 2 ozw 6-oz spoodle = 3 ozw 8-oz spoodle = 4 ozw

nodes.name: Pickled Cucumber
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Combine cucumbers, sugar and salt. Toss to coat. Let stand for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring once. 2. Combine cucumbers and vinegar. Toss to coat. 3. Cover. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in recipe. 4. Drain before serving.

nodes.name: Roasted Garlic Rice
nodes.assembly_instructions: RANGE-TOP METHOD 1. In stockpot over high heat, bring water to a boil. Add rice, oil, salt, pepper and Roasted Garlic. Stir. Return to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. 2. Simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 18 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. OVEN / STEAMER METHOD 1. Preheat oven to 350 F or preheat steamer. FOR EACH 24 (1/2 cup) SERVINGS: 1. In 2" full steam table pan, place the following: 2 qt boiling water 1 lb + 12 oz rice 2 tbl oil 1 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp pepper 2 oz Roasted Garlic Stir. Cover. 2. Bake or steam until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.
